snippet.title: Slaughter Void is Available NOW! - Watch the Trailer!
snippet.description:
SLAUGHTER VOID is a heavy metal dark fantasy slasher where hesitation is death. Chain kills, keep your momentum, shape your build, and slaughter your way into the Void.

Features:
- 36 Handcrafted levels
- A rich story inspired by retro fantasy paperback novels
- Multiple weapons to customize your play style
- A cast of viscous enemies 
- A hub of unique characters to aid in your quest

Join the hunt NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333980/Slaughter_Void/
